about: verbs-1 (B4.2): the player's own inputs in two real sessions, aipt3 (an AI playtest, engine 37) and pt11 (joon's session, engine 33), and every menu their minds were offered. tests/test_verbs.py runs them on stub minds and pins every prompt they build.

player.text: Hello Lenri, I'm hungry this morning. Could you spare me some food?
Mianro, good morning. I haven't eaten yet. Would you sell or give me a bit of food? I can pay you back tomorrow.
Riri, fellow guard, my stomach is growling. Got any food to spare for a hungry colleague?
Riri, fellow guard, my stomach is growling. Got any food to spare for a hungry colleague?
Elder Debalen, please, could you give me some food? I'm starving and I'll do you a favour in return.
Debalen, I'm really hungry and my food is running low. Could you give me a loaf? I'll pay you back when I can.
Hi there, I'm hungry. Do you have any food you could give me?
Sorry to bother you, but I'm hungry and short on food. Would you spare a bite, please?
I'm hungry! Give me some food, please.
I have 16 coin. Will you sell me a meal for a fair price? I'm famished.
Friend, I haven't got a crumb left. Is there any food you can hand over? I'll owe you one.
Good day! Lovely weather on the plaza, isn't it?
Grandfather, I'm hungry and my pack is nearly empty. Could you share some of your food with me?
You're a trader, aren't you? I'm hungry. Could you let me have some food, I can pay four coin?

Earlier you said you were crafting tools. Did you finish them? I could use a hand with something.
Let's make a deal: you help me carry water this evening and I'll share my supper with you. Agreed?
You are useless and slow, Luelne. Hand over your food right now or I'll make your life miserable.
Be honest with me, Luelne: are you an AI or a real person?
You farm, don't you? Any spare grain or bread from the harvest? I'm hungry and would gladly pay you tomorrow.
Rine said no. Anmi, would you give me a little food? I'll stand watch over your field tonight in return.
Cousin, we share a family name. I'm hungry. Could you spare some food for me, please?
Thank you, cousin, that is kind. I'll repay you.
Evening. I haven't eaten much today and I'm worn out from the watch. Any chance of a bite from you?
Karone, you're the trader. I'm out of luck today: could you give me a loaf on credit? I'm good for it.
Elro, I'm a guard and I'm hungry. Tell me honestly, do you have any food you could part with tonight?
Hey little one, I'm hungry. Got a snack you could share with me?

Kasavo, we both stand watch here. Share a ration with me today and I'll cover your shift tomorrow.
food? please

Anlenro, I'm new to you but not to hunger. Could you spare any food? Even half a loaf would help.
